title: Storage options for the per-profile company list
headSub: FIXED by your constraints: per-profile, fully managed in the Settings UI (verify-on-add), resolved per run from effective_config. The only open decision below is HOW the list is stored.
head: Option
Storage
Pros
Cons
Verdict

rows.label: 1. user_config-backed
cells: per-profile JSON list in user_config (no new table); the Settings widget writes it
least machinery; reuses config + per-run effective_config; consistent with search.* / scoring.*
stores slugs (+ light metadata); a profile override replaces the default list

rows.label: 2. Dedicated table
cells: new target_companies table (name, ATS, slug, verified, added_at) + repo + endpoints
first-class model; persists verify status; richest UI surface
new table/repo/endpoints + migration; a 2nd source of truth alongside config; heavier

rows.label: x. Raw config / deps-time
cells: edit config.yaml or PUT dotted keys; global startup factory (today)
violates 'manage from the Settings UI'; not per-user (global, last-reload-wins)

takeaway.text: Recommend Option 1: a {{green:UI-managed}} per-profile list in user_config, verified on add, resolved per run - the permanent fix with the least new machinery.
